# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude when working with this codebase.

## Project Overview

A TypeScript CLI tool for analyzing AI development workflows. Uses Bun runtime with the Claude Agent SDK.

## Development Workflow

```bash
# Install dependencies
bun install

# Run tests (unit and integration)
bun test

# Run linter
bun run lint

# Type check
bun run typecheck

# Build for production
bun run build
```

## Architecture

Layered architecture with clear separation:
- `src/cli/` - Command line interface
- `src/core/` - Business logic
- `src/adapters/` - External integrations
- `tests/` - Unit and integration tests

## Testing Guidelines

- Write tests before implementing features (TDD)
- Unit tests in `tests/unit/`, integration tests in `tests/integration/`
- Use VCR recordings for external API tests
- Target 80% code coverage

## Code Quality

- Follow existing patterns in the codebase
- Use TypeScript strict mode
- All functions should have explicit return types
- Prefer composition over inheritance

## Security

- Never commit secrets or credentials
- Use environment variables for configuration
- Validate all external input
- Follow OWASP guidelines
